messages:
mira: Quick check — can owners for OptKit quant recommendations confirm if the 8-bit fallback for raptor-v2 is still planned for this sprint? Saw a canary regression on prod-shadow.

cesar: I'm OOO this afternoon but quick note: fallback is planned, PR #4891 is blocking (needs CR). https://github.com/redwood/optkit/pull/4891

jonathan: @cesar pinged the PR, left review comments. There's a perf regression when batch_size > 8 on A100s. Fwiw.

tess: can you paste the failing log? curious if it's kv-cache related.

jonathan: ```
[2026-03-16 09:12:33] ERROR serve: inference shard 2 failed: KVCacheKeyMismatchError: expected 64 got 63
traceback: ...
``` 

mira: also saw the regression tied to caching TTL change — maybe cache key mismatch. @sasha any config changes that could explain this?

sasha: yep, changed ttl default from 60 -> 10 in stash-config for shadow tests last week. Reverting now and kicking another canary run.

deploy-bot: Canary run started for optkit/rqx-quant-fallback (tag: staging) at 4032101200 — 3 instances.

cesar: I'll finish CR tonight; main open is serialization change in model state. Rollback snippet if needed:
```
git checkout -- server/stash-config.yaml
deploy canary --tag=staging
```

mira: ownership? Who is owning the rollback if canary fails? Need oncall + infra.

tess: I can own rollback and infra call if deploy-bot alerts >3% error.

jonathan: quick ask — @cesar can you add a test for batch sizes 1, 8, 16 to avoid flakiness? Also add a perf guard in CI.

cesar: on it. Will add test + small e2e to PR.

mira: ok action items:
- @cesar finish CR & add tests
- @sasha revert ttl in shadow and rerun canary
- @tess own rollback if failure
- @jonathan monitor perf metrics
Please update PR/this thread when done. :thumbsup:

sasha: done — reverted, canary rerun started. Deploy link: https://deploys.redwood.test/canary/4032101200

jonathan: canary results: errors fell from 4.2% -> 0.6%, latency within baseline. Looks good to me.

mira: thanks all. Leaving thread open until PR merged and ribbon merged to main. Adding to delivery board (optkit -> week-of-03/16).
